description: Gap themes raised by curation and the changes that addressed them.

themes.title: Product lumps (C5+, C5-C11, C2-C4 olefins) have no target concept
themes.decision: schema change (additive, provisional): ProductLump label, SUBSET_OF edge, selectivity-sum check reads containment
themes.motivating_records: Issue 39: 79 lump nodes in 14 FTS documents, each a ChemicalSpecies with species_kind other; on Cheng Cat-12h the sum check warned 191.8 % because C5-C11, C10-C20 and C21+ lie inside C5+.

concepts_considered.ChemicalSpecies (species_kind other, sco: kept for single identities; a lump has no formula, and the carbon window and class would stay free text, so no comparison or containment check
concepts_considered.value qualifiers (target, basis): carry which lump a value is for, but need a node to point at with a range and a class
concepts_considered.ChEBI classes: give a compound class but no carbon window; may fill compound_class later, no identifiers invented here

themes.rights: Only the two short quoted column headers above are stored, as evidence quotes; both sources are CC BY 4.0. No source text beyond them is committed.
themes.convention_limit: Comparison across documents relies on curators filling carbon_min, open_ended and compound_class on each ProductLump; a lump whose properties are unstated is missed by such a plan. No shared lump ids are provided: each document mints its own.
unreported_gaps: A species inside a lump (CH4 in C1, ethene in C2-C4 olefins) cannot be declared, because SUBSET_OF links a lump to a lump only; selectivities on a species and on its lump can therefore be summed together.
Lyu's O/P ratio (C2-C4) is not modelled.
The selectivity basis and denominator are to be reported separately and are not modelled here.
Boiling-range lumps (for example by distillation cut) are not modelled.
The sum check drops any container lump from the sum, so an undeclared overlap beneath a declared container goes unseen.
